Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment involves two distinct proteomics assays: a secretome analysis and a cell-derived matrix analysis. Both used TMT 10-plex labeling and DDA (SPS-MS3) on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or glyco) was performed; the 'secretome' and 'matrix' are sample-type fractions, not PTM-based enrichments.

scope: To obtain the proteome from the cell-derived matrix, cells were grown in 15 cm dishes for seven days in media supplemented with 50 µg ml–1 ascorbate

Upon sample collection cells were rinsed with ice-cold PBS and extracted in 8 ml 20 mM ammonium hydroxide and 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 2 min on a shaker with subsequent repeated rinsing in ice-cold PBS and incubation with 10 µg ml–1 DNaseI for 30 min at 37°C.
Following knockout of Mia3 encoding both TANGO1S and TANGO1L we have analysed the extracellular matrix deposited by these cells using TMT mass spectrometry.
